ns2:course.label: Introduction to Medical Ethics
ns2:course.description: Course stresses normative bioethics: decisions about what is ethical behavior in a variety of real and practical issues. Analysis of medical ethical cases at the individual, community and wider national and international levels will be addressed. Approved for both letter and S/U grading.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for both letter and S/U grading.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
